verification_status_label: Prospective live scoring is active for matured tornado forecasts.
metric_source_label: Pooled over 234675 storm forecasts from 1737 matured live forecasts against SPC reports; base rate 0.00270, mean forecast 0.07562. BSS reference: base rate of outcomes that had matured before each forecast was issued. Served-probability split: raw model: BSS -13.334 over 92634 storm forecasts; calibrated: BSS 0.002 over 142041 storm forecasts.
homepage_line: 1737 matured forecasts scored · BSS -8.48 vs climatology

prospective.outcome_time_convention: SPC daily files are convective days (12 UTC to 12 UTC); HHMM is UTC; rows before 1200 are placed on the next UTC date
prospective.skill_reference: bss_vs_causal_climatology: reference = base rate of all storm-forecasts whose 24 h window matured before the forecast was issued (no outcome leak). bss_vs_sample_climatology: reference = pooled base rate of the scored set itself (in-sample, shown for comparison).

related_benchmark.label: A historical 2024 holdout benchmark exists for a related tornado GBT family, but not yet as an exact score for the live storm-object model. Its Brier/BSS were measured at a downsampled base rate of 0.167 and are not comparable to live skill at the natural base rate.

recommended_action: Judge the live tornado model on the pooled BSS against causal climatology (and its served-probability split), not on per-forecast means or the downsampled research holdout.
